breakdown.title: The Key and the Boat
breakdown.logline: The dreamer climbs a winding stone stair with a dog and a key, then finds their father folding newspaper boats in a tower room; after the sea becomes a field, they ride a tractor and leave the boat in the grass.

colours.value: grey, cold, pale light, tall yellow grass, red tractor, newspaper

light.value: diffused grey light inside the stair and room; soft daylight over the field

texture.value: rough stone, dry paper, warm metal key, grass

breakdown.world_logic: A world where the sea can vanish and become a field, and where you can suddenly be in a tractor without travelling there; everything feels quiet and slow.

identity.value: a dog, presumably the dreamer's or known to them

geography.value: a spiral staircase winding up, stone steps

geography.value: a room at the top of the stairs, with windows all round

landmarks.value: windows all round, a table where the father sits

light.value: grey and cold, like the stair

appearance.value: a little boat folded from newspaper

materials.value: newspaper, dry and a bit rough, with fold marks from fingers

scenes.title: Climbing the Stair
scenes.mood: grey, cold, echoing, sense of following blindly

moments.action: The dog runs up the stone stairs ahead of the dreamer, fast, as if he already knows the way.
moments.visual_point: the dog racing up the winding stone steps
moments.purpose: sets the scene and the dog's role

moments.action: The dreamer follows up the stairs, holding the key, listening to the click of the dog's claws echoing on the stone.
moments.feeling: grey, cold, echoing, focused on sound
moments.visual_point: the dreamer's hand closed around the key
moments.purpose: establishing the climb and the key

moments.action: The stone steps wind round and round upward, the dog unseen ahead; the dreamer listens to claws on stone.

scenes.title: The Room with Windows All Round
scenes.mood: quiet, waiting, still grey and cold

moments.action: The dreamer reaches the top and enters a room with windows all round; the father sits at a table, folding little boats from newspaper, not looking up.
moments.visual_point: the father folding boats, not looking up

moments.action: The father hands one of the folded newspaper boats to the dreamer, still without speaking.
moments.visual_point: the boat in the father's hand reaching to the dreamer

moments.action: The dreamer looks out through the window; the sea is gone, replaced by a field of tall yellow grass with a red tractor driving slowly through it.
moments.looks_at: the window and the view beyond
moments.visual_point: the sea become a yellow field with a red tractor
moments.shift: the sea outside the window has become a field of tall yellow grass
moments.dream: the sea is gone, replaced by a field

moments.action: The dreamer looks back down at the boat in their hand; the paper is dry and rough, with the marks of the father's folds.
moments.looks_at: the boat in the dreamer's hand
moments.feeling: the boat as the only solid thing left
moments.visual_point: the folded newspaper boat with visible fold marks

blocking.front: the wall with the door from the stairs

moments.action: Suddenly the dreamer is in the tractor, sitting next to the driver, a stranger, still holding the boat.
moments.looks_at: the dreamer and driver in the tractor cab
moments.visual_point: the dreamer beside the stranger in the tractor
moments.shift: the dreamer is suddenly in the tractor, no climb down

moments.action: The red tractor drives slowly through the tall yellow grass, stopping at the edge of the field where the beach used to be.
moments.looks_at: the tractor at the edge of the grass
moments.visual_point: the tractor at the field's edge, grass where beach once was

moments.action: The dreamer places the newspaper boat down in the grass at the edge, leaving it there.
moments.visual_point: the boat set down in the grass

blocking.front: the edge of the field where the beach used to be

m1.text: The shot is seen from in front of the dog, close, at the height of the dog's eyes, using a 14mm lens. The camera looks slightly downward toward the dog and the bottom of the stairs. In the foreground, the dog fills the picture from left to right and from top to bottom, facing the camera, its whole body visible as it runs up the stairs. Behind the dog, across the picture from left to right, are the bottom of the stone stairs and the front of the place, with no other people or animals in view. The light comes from an open doorway at the top of the stairs, out of frame behind the camera, so the dog is lit from the front. Out of frame on either side are the stone walls or railings of the stairway.
m1.view: Seen from in front of the dog, close, at the height of the dog's eyes: the camera looks at the dog, toward the bottom of the stairs. A 14mm lens. Nobody else is in the picture. Across the picture from the left third to the right third: the bottom of the stairs, the front of the place.

m8.text: The camera is about two metres in front of the two figures, level with their eyes, using a 35mm lens. In the left third of the picture, the dreamer sits facing the camera, cut off at the knees and filling the frame from near the top to the bottom edge; in their hands at the left edge they hold the boat, its hull running from low down to near the bottom. In the right third of the picture, the driver sits facing the camera, also cut off at the knees and filling the frame from near the top to the bottom edge. The background behind them is the far side of the place, slightly out of focus. The light is even daylight from behind the camera, with no strong shadows. Just outside the picture behind the camera is the edge of the field where the beach used to be.
